title.zh: 儿童插珠帐篷拼搭玩具

summary.zh:
这是一款儿童插珠帐篷拼搭玩具，采用PP结构件，适用于家庭互动、课堂活动和创意搭建场景。

产地东莞茶山，支持拆装房子玩法，配有导购视频素材。
summary.en:
This is a kids fort building toy made with PP structural parts, suitable for family interaction, classroom activities, and creative construction scenarios.

Produced in Chashan, Dongguan, it supports detachable-house play and includes guide-video assets.

zh: 该款儿童插珠帐篷拼搭玩具采用模块化拼接结构，可围绕帐篷、堡垒和通道进行多形态搭建，适合儿童持续创意构建。
产品适用于亲子互动、课程教具和活动场景布置，可用于动手能力、手眼协调和协作玩法训练。
包装为彩盒，结构简洁，便于渠道上架和批量供货。
en: This kids fort building toy uses a modular interlocking structure and supports multiple layouts around tents, forts, and tunnels for continuous creative construction play.
It is suitable for parent-child interaction, educational props, and event-space setup, helping develop hands-on ability, hand-eye coordination, and collaborative play skills.
The product uses color-box packaging with a streamlined structure suitable for channel listing and bulk supply.

value.zh: 情感、视觉、智力开发、爬行、动手动脑、抓握、感官、手眼协调、互动玩具、亲子交流、兴趣培养
value.en: Emotion, visual perception, cognitive development, crawling, hands-on practice, grasping, sensory training, hand-eye coordination, interactive play, parent-child interaction, and interest cultivation
